observations: The alpha channel contains every value from 0 through 255; it is a continuous lawn/soil selector, not a binary opacity card.
At decoded x=256, y=260 the selector is clean soil alpha 0.
The recovered wavy transition band spans approximately decoded y=260 through y=336 and reaches source lawn alpha near 1 while retaining white RGB modulation.
FieldGroundShader01 inverts source UV2 V before sampling the lawn/soil mask.

implementation_contract.canonical_surface_reconstruction: Each generated flat tile barycentrically samples the canonical Route 1 ground triangles at a 9 by 9 lattice. Height, UV0, UV1, UV2, and Color0 therefore reproduce the exact source surface instead of an inferred one-metre UV repeat.
implementation_contract.lawn_uv_continuity: Every generated boundary vertex uses the canonical source triangle attributes at the same source-space position. This preserves the authored greenblend01_com phase, color field, mask UV, and mip derivatives where an edited cell meets untouched route geometry.
implementation_contract.lawn_variants: Auto is the source-identical base. Explicit Lawn A through D apply small UV0 offsets only inside the cell through a squared-sine envelope whose value and first derivative both reach zero on all four edges.
implementation_contract.geometric_seam_control: Generated top surfaces use a 0.02 cm depth safety bias. This is enough to avoid coplanar flicker without exposing the dark vertical seam produced by the previous 0.5 cm lift.
implementation_contract.dirt_transition_sampling: Subdivided flat dirt tiles sample the recovered glassmask01_com transition band rather than a generated square alpha texture.
implementation_contract.automatic_connectivity: Auto Connected derives NESW links from same-height neighboring authored dirt cells.
implementation_contract.manual_connectivity: The Inspector exposes all 16 NESW masks: isolated, four ends, four corners, two straights, four T-junctions, and full dirt.
implementation_contract.persistence: The authored-scene terrain binding stores visual_variant separately from surface and shape; schema 1 and schema 2 scenes load with visual_variant=auto.

claim_boundary: LGPE stores continuous route-authored ground paint rather than a reusable 1 m tile atlas. The modular tile topology is an editor/runtime reconstruction that reuses the exact recovered material, UV semantics, and source transition signal; it is not claimed to be an original Game Freak tile index table.
